items.item:
1. After Kernel ends a session, reading its access is refused.
   Shows A11-1. [witness: verification:registry_a11_ended_session_access_read_refused]
statements:
```text
end(x) accepted => not registered(x) and no record of x remains   -- A11-1
register(x) after end(x) => granted(x) = {} and active(x) = none   -- A11-2
```

verdicts.why: The selected test asserts that Kernel accepts the end, subsequent access reading is refused as an unregistered-session call, and the session is absent from the owner-visible list. It does not inspect persistence to prove that no record of the session remains, and it does not assert the re-registration requirements of A11-2.
